extension.summary: Network test pattern generator for Calman, HCFR, DeviceControl, LightSpace and Resolve clients
extension.disclaimer: Work in progress: the patterns may be inaccurate. If you use them, validate your results against another source.
extension.description: Turns Kodi into a calibration pattern source. Calman connects over UPGCI (TCP 2100 / RPC 2101, UDP discovery), HCFR and DeviceControl over PGenerator's classic protocol (TCP 85, UDP 1977 discovery), LightSpace / ColourSpace through its UDP 20123 trigger, or the generator connects out to a Resolve target (Calman, HCFR, DisplayCAL). Each requested pattern is encoded bit-exactly as HEVC Main10 and played fullscreen, so the display receives it through the normal video path: SDR, HDR10, HLG or Dolby Vision (profile 5). Tested only on CoreELEC (Amlogic). Amlogic only: the continuous stream (patterns follow each other in one stream, so the signal stays on between them), waiting for the HDR signal and for an output-mode change before a pattern counts as shown, and the HDMI output readout; elsewhere each pattern is its own clip and the HDMI readout shows "not available".
